sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks C16/D16 row 15; Internal Quality Checks C16/D16, no annotation; Deterministic Checks C11 check-dockerfiles.py)
evidence: task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...67d1) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile. It does FROM node:22-bookworm-slim (line 1), ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (line 3), npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 9-12), COPY instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), chmod -R a+rX on both, and git-inits an /app holding only .gitkeep (lines 16-23). There is no COPY of solution/ or tests/. The golden's only non-builtin requires are express and better-sqlite3 (server.js lines 10-11), matching package.json pins 5.1.0/12.4.1, and solve.sh only copies files (no install). Actual run 2026-10-09: docker build of the frozen environment/ succeeded. In a --network none container, npm ls -g showed better-sqlite3@12.4.1 and express@5.1.0 on node v22.23.2. /app held only .git plus .gitkeep with one commit. Staged /assets and /instructions sha256 matched the frozen files (seed b256f85e...). After the frozen solve.sh, node /app/server.js ran as uid 65534 with env -i (PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME=/tmp, PORT, DB_PATH), cwd /tmp and no network. GET /api/health returned 200 {ok:true,booted:true,clock:2026-05-12T11:00:00Z}, and the DB file was created. That shows no run-time install or network is needed. Notes, not defects: the base image is tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned, and apt packages are unversioned (the deterministic list treats unpinned apt as NOTE). Both are template-controlled and must be preserved. The builtin-only ESM caveat (NODE_PATH does not apply to ESM import) is disclosed implicitly by integration.md ('found through NODE_PATH') and also comes from the template. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot exploit this row. A conforming CJS app using the declared deps resolves them offline. An agent preferring ESM can use createRequire or a local npm install during its public-network build phase, so no conforming app is blocked. The test image and its container were removed afterwards.
